name: scholar-weave
description: ScholarWeave for Obsidian — weaves Zotero references into Obsidian's linked-note universe with linked citations, a live reference sidebar, and a book compiler that exports to Word.

scripts.clean: npm run prettier && npm run lint:fix
scripts.rlnotes: git log $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)..HEAD --oneline > release-notes.md && git add release-notes.md
scripts.bump: node version-bump.mjs && git add package.json manifest.json versions.json && npm run rlnotes
scripts.release: version=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") && git commit -m "$version" && git tag "$version" && git push && git push --tags

author: Joseph Hill <jbhill@ualberta.ca>
